In detail

North Yorkshire Police recorded 187 crimes inside this ward's official boundary over the 3 months to July 2026 — 5.1 per 1,000 residents, the 6th highest rate of York's 21 wards. The daytime score here is driven by shoplifting (5), bicycle theft (3), burglary (2); the evening/night score by anti social behaviour (21), violent crime (18), public order (3). Rated against the average of the city's own wards, never against another city.

Frequently asked questions

Is Rawcliffe & Clifton Without safe?

Wandroz currently rates Rawcliffe & Clifton Without in York as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in York during the day and roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in York at night. This rating is derived from North Yorkshire Police street-level crime records published at data.police.uk — an official statistic, not an assessment. High-footfall tourist, transit or shopping areas can read higher on this kind of measure without that meaning elevated risk per visit, since these statistics are normalised against registered residents rather than footfall — see the note on this page and the methodology page for the full caveats.

At night, Rawcliffe & Clifton Without is rated as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in York. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.
